about.title: About
about.unofficialDetail: This is an independent project. For official information, check EMT Málaga's own channels.
about.dataSource: Lines, stops and routes come from the Málaga City Council open data portal (EMT Málaga).
about.dataDisclaimer: The data may contain errors or be out of date. Routes marked as approximate join the stops with straight lines.
about.privacy: No accounts or analytics. Only your settings, your favourites and the latest copy of the data are stored on this device. Your location is only requested when you open "Near me" or choose it as the starting point, and it is never stored or sent. To download the data and the map the app connects to GitHub Pages and OpenFreeMap, which can see your IP address like any website.

data.unavailable: No data available. Check your connection and try again.
data.outdated: The data could not be updated. Showing data from {{date}}, which may be out of date.

plan.title: Get there
plan.samePlace: The start and the destination are the same place.
plan.noOptions: No lines go from the start to the destination, either direct or with one change.
plan.timesNote: Times from EMT's published timetable, not real time. The recommended option arrives first (or, with “Arrive by”, leaves latest).
plan.estimatedNote: A line in this option has no published timetable: its time is estimated from distance.
plan.nightNote: Includes a night line: it only runs at night.
plan.noService: no buses today or tomorrow per the timetable
plan.noServiceArrive: cannot arrive in time per the timetable
plan.noStopsNearYou: There are no stops within 1 km of your location.
